== Course of events ==

After the travelers, led by the Tin Woodman wielding his axe, frightened off the Army of Revolt guards and entered the Emerald City unopposed, and after the Scarecrow released the mice hidden in his straw stuffing to send the Army of Revolt and Jinjur fleeing the palace in panic, the Scarecrow thought quietly before speaking. He then proposed building a flying machine on the roof and using the Powder of Life to animate it, naming the Tin Woodman as the one to build it.

The proposal joined Nick Chopper and the Scarecrow around a single plan: a machine built by the Tin Woodman's hand and brought to life by the Powder of Life, meant to be raised on the roof of the palace. It followed directly from the Scarecrow's quiet thinking, marking a shift from the chaos of the mice and the fleeing Army of Revolt toward a deliberate scheme for what to do next.

The proposal came shortly before the Scarecrow argued that Jinjur was rightfully Queen and that the group had no claim to occupy her palace, before he declared that they could not remain shut inside and called for a plan of escape, and before he removed his crown and reflected that Jinjur might now claim it. The flying machine, built by the Tin Woodman and animated by the Powder of Life, thus took shape as the escape the Scarecrow would soon insist upon.
